entries.name: UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.RecTExists
entries.what: a proposition without arguments, which is a statement and not a proved theorem
entries.says: It is the statement that, for every number field E, every algebraic closure Ω of E, every valuation subring A of Ω, every height one prime w of the ring of integers of E, and every proof h that A lies over w, there exists a map rc for which the condition IsRecT h rc holds. The map rc goes from the type the code calls IrrGL, taken over the completion of E at w, to the type the code calls WD h. IsRecT h rc says that there exist a group homomorphism a from the object called Weil h to the units of that completion, and a proof ha that a satisfies IsLocalArtin, such that the twelve laws bundled in LawsT hold for a, ha and rc. The definition only names this statement and does not prove it.

parts.name: E Ω
parts.gloss: E is any type carrying a field structure that is a number field. Ω is any field that is an algebra over E and an algebraic closure of E.

parts.name: A
parts.gloss: A is any valuation subring of Ω, that is, a subring that contains x or the inverse of x for every nonzero x in Ω.

parts.name: w
parts.gloss: w is any element of the height one spectrum of 𝓞 E, the ring of integers of E, which is the set of its nonzero prime ideals.

parts.name: h
parts.gloss: h is a proof of IsPlaceOver A w. The dossier shows this to mean that, for every x in the ring of integers of E, the valuation attached to A of the image of x in Ω is less than 1 exactly when x lies in the prime ideal w.

parts.name: ∃ rc
parts.gloss: The statement asserts the existence of a function rc from IrrGL over the completion of E at w to WD h. IrrGL is the type of pairs of a natural number n and an element of IrrCl of the group GL of n by n matrices over that completion, where IrrCl is a quotient of the record type IrrRep (a complex vector space with a representation marked smooth and irreducible). WD h is the quotient of pairs (n, an object of type WDRep h on ℂ^n) by the relation the code calls Iso.

parts.name: IsRecT h rc
parts.gloss: This says that there exist a homomorphism a from Weil h to the units of the completion and a proof ha of IsLocalArtin h a such that LawsT a ha rc holds. IsLocalArtin has five fields named surj, cont, ord_eq, factor and glob, the first being that a is surjective. LawsT is a conjunction of twelve conditions on rc named dim, one, langlands, cusp, nu, absCentral, twist, central, dual, inj, depth and type. For example, dim says that the quantity lpDim of rc x equals the number n of x for every x, and inj says that rc x = rc y forces x = y whenever y satisfies the condition called Good.

entries.suggests: The names suggest that this is the existence half of the local Langlands correspondence for GL_n over the completion of a number field at a finite place, with rc a reciprocity map from irreducible smooth representations to Weil–Deligne representation classes, normalised by a local Artin map a. The letter T may mark a variant of the list of laws, which the text does not explain.
entries.why: The quantifier structure, IsPlaceOver, IsRecT, and the field lists of LawsT and IsLocalArtin are fully visible, but many names inside those laws (such as Weil, WDRep, Good and TypeLaw) were not opened in the dossier, which reached its limit of 60,000 characters partway through level 3.

second.kind: a proposition (a Lean def of type Prop) that asserts existence for every choice of data
second.says: RecTExists is a proposition with no arguments of its own, because it quantifies again over everything it needs. It states that for every type E that is a field and a number field, every type Ω that is a field, an algebra over E and an algebraic closure of E, every valuation subring A of Ω, every height one prime w of the ring of integers of E, and every proof h that A is a place over w, there exists a map rc such that IsRecT h rc holds. By the lower levels, rc is a map from IrrGL of the completion of E at w to WD h, where IrrGL is the type of pairs of a natural number n and a class of irreducible representations of GL of size n over that completion, and WD h is a quotient of pairs of a natural number n and a WDRep on the functions from Fin n to the complex numbers by the relation the code calls Iso. IsRecT h rc says that there exist a group homomorphism a from Weil h to the units of the completion and a proof ha of IsLocalArtin h a such that the structure LawsT a ha rc holds. LawsT is a bundle of twelve laws on rc named dim, one, langlands, cusp, nu, absCentral, twist, central, dual, inj, depth and type.

parts.name: E Ω
parts.gloss: The statement is universally quantified over two types E and Ω in the lowest universe.

parts.name: [Field E] [NumberField E]
parts.gloss: E is required to be a field and a number field.

parts.name: [Field Ω] [Algebra E Ω] [IsAlgClosure E Ω]
parts.gloss: Ω is required to be a field, an algebra over E, and an algebraic closure of E.

parts.name: A
parts.gloss: A ranges over all valuation subrings of Ω.

parts.name: w
parts.gloss: w ranges over all elements of the height one spectrum of the ring of integers of E.

parts.name: h
parts.gloss: h ranges over all proofs of IsPlaceOver A w, which says that for every x in the ring of integers of E the valuation of A on the image of x in Ω is less than 1 if and only if x lies in the ideal of w.

parts.name: ∃ rc
parts.gloss: The conclusion asserts the existence of some rc, which by the signature of IsRecT is a map from IrrGL of the completion of E at w to WD h.

parts.name: IsRecT h rc
parts.gloss: This is the property required of rc, namely that there exist a homomorphism a from Weil h to the units of the completion of E at w and a proof ha of IsLocalArtin h a such that LawsT a ha rc holds, where LawsT has the twelve fields dim, one, langlands, cusp, nu, absCentral, twist, central, dual, inj, depth and type in that order.

entries.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.D7
entries.what: a record type (a Lean structure) with 141 fields, mixing data and conditions on that data
entries.says: D7 is a record type with no parameters, and an object of it is one large bundle of data together with proofs of conditions tying the data together. It starts from a rank record R, a host record over R, a family of Hermitian spaces sp, a rows record what₂, and a family of members mem u indexed by the words of what₂ with a base word u₀. It then asks that the field what₂.LL is a totally complex number field, Galois over ℚ, with a star operation, and it adds lattice data div, a commutative group Dt with characters muTil and chiD, a record s, local theories loc, locA and locT at every prime, a chain of records nd, ntw, naut, nbc, nexp, ntypes and nth, form data fm, a measure record cd, jet data jet and extra data gx and gat. The conditions are mostly equalities and equivalences that identify pieces of one record with pieces of another, for example the two formulas that give rhoDet as the inverse of muTil (i+1) times a power of chiD with exponent −(R.N (i+1))/2, and rhoDet' as muTil (i+1) times a power of chiD with exponent (R.N i)/2. Nothing is proved here, since the structure only lists what such a bundle must contain.

parts.name: R
parts.gloss: An object of the record type Ranks. The dossier shows that this holds natural numbers k, m, t with k and m even, t odd, 2 ≤ m, m + 3 ≤ k, k + m − 1 + 5 ≤ t, 3·m < t and further inequalities, on top of an unopened record Formalism.HC.Frame.

parts.name: host
parts.gloss: An object of the record type Host R. The dossier shows that it extends an unopened record Formalism.HC.HostAx and adds, among much else, an embedding φ₀ of the field E into ℂ, a finite set levelPrimes, two distinct primes g 0 and g 1 in that set, and two distinct primes pde and pde' that are 1 modulo 15.

parts.name: sp
parts.gloss: An object of the record type Spaces, built for R, the fields host.F and host.E and the star operation host.cmStar. The dossier shows that it holds a prime T and families X, Y, W, V of objects of type HSpace host.E, which are finite-dimensional spaces with a nondegenerate Hermitian form hT and a lattice L0, plus linear maps and rank conditions between them.

parts.name: vol
parts.gloss: A function that gives a real number to every object of type HSpace host.E.

parts.name: vol_pos
parts.gloss: The condition that vol W is greater than 0 for every W.

parts.name: what₂
parts.gloss: An object of the record type Rows.Data R. The dossier shows that it holds a field LL with a ring map embLL into ℂ, a places record, a ring O with a map OtoLL into LL, a finite type Tau with R.f elements, a type Tup with marked elements mu0, muStar, muStar', a type Word, finite-dimensional complex inner product spaces EE, Amb μ and Mu u, and functions perCol and Bu.

parts.name: eTau
parts.gloss: A bijection between the type what₂.Tau and the set that the code calls R.Psi.

parts.name: hc
parts.gloss: A function that gives to each τ in Tau an object of type HCParam R. The dossier shows that such an object holds rational sequences u, v, b, e with interlacing and gap inequalities, with u taking half-integer values and v, b, e taking integer values.

parts.name: wordFin
parts.gloss: The requirement that the type what₂.Word is finite, given as an instance.

parts.name: u₀
parts.gloss: A chosen element of what₂.Word, used below as the base word.

parts.name: hcW
parts.gloss: A function that gives an object of type HCParam R to each word u and each τ in Tau.

parts.name: hcW_base
parts.gloss: The condition that hcW at the base word u₀ equals hc.

parts.name: hcW_v
parts.gloss: The condition that for all u and τ the v-component of hcW u τ equals the v-component of hc τ.

parts.name: hcW_b
parts.gloss: The condition that for all u and τ the b-component of hcW u τ equals the b-component of hc τ.

parts.name: hcW_e
parts.gloss: The condition that for all u and τ the e-component of hcW u τ equals the e-component of hc τ.

parts.name: hcW_first
parts.gloss: The condition that, when 0 < R.k, the entry of index 0 of the u-component of hcW u τ equals that of hc τ, for all u and τ.

parts.name: hcW_last
parts.gloss: The condition that, when 0 < R.k, the entry of index R.k − 1 of the u-component of hcW u τ equals that of hc τ, for all u and τ.

parts.name: mem
parts.gloss: A function that gives to each word u an object of type Member R what₂.Tau (hcW u). The dossier shows that a member is a triple of a column chain C, an object A of the unopened type ColumnsAtT R C, and a period map P.

parts.name: nfLL
parts.gloss: The requirement that what₂.LL is a number field, given as an instance.

parts.name: starLL
parts.gloss: A star operation on what₂.LL, that is an involution compatible with the ring structure, given as an instance.

parts.name: tcLL
parts.gloss: The requirement that the number field what₂.LL is totally complex, given as an instance.

parts.name: galLL
parts.gloss: The requirement that what₂.LL is a Galois extension of ℚ, given as an instance.

parts.name: starLL_cx
parts.gloss: The condition that embLL carries the star of x to the complex conjugate of embLL x, for every x in LL.

parts.name: div
parts.gloss: An object of the record type DivData what₂.LL what₂.Word. The dossier shows that it holds an object RR and a family Nu u of the unopened type HLat, linear maps Bk, real numbers h u, HH, etaF and delP with delP ≤ 1, a natural number Dall, and one inequality on HH.

parts.name: div_good
parts.gloss: A conjunction of two conditions. The matrix (div.RR.X v) has invertible determinant for every v, and the matrix ((div.Nu u).X v) has invertible determinant for all u and v.

parts.name: embE
parts.gloss: A ring homomorphism from the field host.E into what₂.LL.

parts.name: embE_φ₀
parts.gloss: The condition that embLL composed with embE equals the embedding host.φ₀ of host.E into ℂ.

parts.name: conjF
parts.gloss: An algebra homomorphism from host.E to itself over host.F.

parts.name: conjF_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that conjF x equals host.conj x for every x.

parts.name: embE_conj
parts.gloss: The condition that embE carries host.conj x to the star of embE x, for every x in host.E.

parts.name: LL0
parts.gloss: An intermediate field between ℚ and what₂.LL.

parts.name: hostField_le_fixedField
parts.gloss: The condition that embE x lies in LL0 for every x in host.E.

parts.name: O_int
parts.gloss: The condition that the image in LL of every element of the ring what₂.O is integral over ℤ.

parts.name: O_contains
parts.gloss: The condition that for every x in the ring of integers of host.E there is a y in what₂.O whose image in LL equals embE x.

parts.name: plEq
parts.gloss: A bijection between the type what₂.places.Pl and the set of nonzero prime ideals of the ring of integers of what₂.LL (written HeightOneSpectrum).

parts.name: val_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that for every w and every nonzero x in LL the value what₂.places.val w x equals vAdd (plEq w) x. The dossier shows vAdd to be minus the logarithm of the valuation at that prime, an integer.

parts.name: ram_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that what₂.places.ramIdx w equals eWL of plEq w for every w. The dossier shows eWL to be the ramification index of that prime ideal over ℤ.

parts.name: conj_val
parts.gloss: The condition that the value of x at the place what₂.places.conj w equals the value of star x at w, for all w and x.

parts.name: T_level
parts.gloss: The condition that the number (mem u).A.T lies in the finite set host.levelPrimes for every word u.

parts.name: T_norm
parts.gloss: The condition that for every word u there is an integer π of host.E that lies in host.K, satisfies π · host.conj π = (mem u).A.T, and has π − 1 in the ideal generated by the natural number host.QS · host.q · host.d · (host.g 0 · host.g 1)^2.

parts.name: sp_T
parts.gloss: The condition that the prime sp.T of the spaces record equals (mem u₀).A.T, the number attached to the member at the base word.

parts.name: cOf
parts.gloss: A function from words to elements of host.E.

parts.name: cOf_ne
parts.gloss: The condition that cOf u is nonzero for every u.

parts.name: cOf_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that cOf u · host.conj (cOf u) · (mem u).A.T equals (mem u₀).A.T in host.E, for every u.

parts.name: T_win
parts.gloss: The condition that for every u the real number (mem u).A.Tstar is at most (mem u).A.T, and (mem u).A.T is at most (1 + 1/(R.f · R.k)) · (mem u).A.Tstar.

parts.name: GamP_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that (mem u).A.GamP equals (mem u₀).A.GamP for every u.

parts.name: T_ne_pde
parts.gloss: The condition that (mem u).A.T differs from host.pde and from host.pde' for every u.

parts.name: Dstar_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that (mem u).A.Dstar equals the real number what₂.Dstar for every u.

parts.name: clsLat
parts.gloss: A function that gives, for each word u, index i and element c of (mem u).C.cls i, a submodule over the ring of integers of host.E inside the space (sp.X i).V.

parts.name: clsLat_lat
parts.gloss: The condition that each clsLat u i c is a full lattice over host.E, in the sense of the library predicate Submodule.IsFullLattice.

parts.name: eMu
parts.gloss: For each word u, a complex linear isomorphism from the space what₂.Mu u onto (mem u).A.Mram.

parts.name: eMt
parts.gloss: For each word u, a complex linear isomorphism from (mem u).P.Mt onto the space what₂.Amb what₂.mu0.

parts.name: perCol_base_eq_PtilCol
parts.gloss: The condition that for all u, φ in Mu u and F in Amb mu0, the number what₂.perCol u mu0 φ F equals (mem u).P.PtilCol applied to the image of φ under eMu u, read as a function on cls 0 and Y 0, and to the preimage of F under eMt u.

parts.name: Bu_linL
parts.gloss: The condition that what₂.Bu u φ F is complex linear in φ for every u and every fixed F.

parts.name: Bu_linR
parts.gloss: The condition that what₂.Bu u φ F is complex linear in F for every u and every fixed φ.

parts.name: chTw
parts.gloss: A function that gives, for each word u and each element of what₂.Tup, an object of type ColumnChain R what₂.Tau (hcW u). The dossier shows that a column chain holds finite types cls i, finite groups stab i c, types Y i, complex numbers rhoDet and rhoDet' of absolute value 1 below index R.m, and linear maps unf.

parts.name: memberColumns_twistedChain_base
parts.gloss: The condition that chTw u at the tuple mu0 equals the column chain (mem u).C, for every u.

parts.name: e0Tw
parts.gloss: For all u and μ, a complex linear isomorphism from the functions cls 0 → Y 0 → ℂ of the chain (mem u).C onto the same kind of function space of the chain chTw u μ.

parts.name: PTw
parts.gloss: For all u and μ, an object of type PeriodMap R (chTw u μ). The dossier shows that a period map holds complex vector spaces Mt, Wz, Wrow and linear maps evz, lowerMap and period.

parts.name: eMtTw
parts.gloss: For all u and μ, a complex linear isomorphism from (PTw u μ).Mt onto what₂.Amb μ.

parts.name: perCol_tie
parts.gloss: The condition that for all u and all μ different from mu0, and all φ and F, the number what₂.perCol u μ φ F equals (PTw u μ).PtilCol applied to e0Tw u μ of the image of φ under eMu u, and to the preimage of F under eMtTw u μ.

parts.name: jEE
parts.gloss: A map from div.RR.V into what₂.EE that is additive and semilinear along embLL, meaning that scalars from LL act on the target through embLL.

parts.name: jEE_basis
parts.gloss: The condition that the images under jEE of the vectors div.RR.b i are linearly independent over ℂ and span all of EE.

parts.name: jN
parts.gloss: For each u, a map from (div.Nu u).V into what₂.Mu u that is semilinear along embLL.

parts.name: jN_basis
parts.gloss: The condition that for each u the images under jN u of the vectors (div.Nu u).b i are linearly independent over ℂ and span all of Mu u.

parts.name: Dall_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that the natural number div.Dall equals what₂.Dall.

parts.name: delP_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that the real number div.delP equals what₂.delp.

parts.name: Dt
parts.gloss: A type, with no further description at this point.

parts.name: instDt
parts.gloss: A commutative group structure on Dt, given as an instance.

parts.name: detCls
parts.gloss: A function that gives an element of Dt to each u, i and element of (mem u).C.cls i.

parts.name: muTil
parts.gloss: For each natural number, a group homomorphism from Dt to the nonzero complex numbers.

parts.name: chiD
parts.gloss: A group homomorphism from Dt to the nonzero complex numbers.

parts.name: UO
parts.gloss: A subgroup of Dt.

parts.name: chiD_UO
parts.gloss: The condition that chiD takes the value 1 on every element of UO.

parts.name: e1Dt
parts.gloss: A group homomorphism into Dt from the unitary elements of host.E, that is the elements whose product with their star is 1.

parts.name: rest_detCharacter_on_unitary_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that for every unitary z in host.E the complex number chiD (e1Dt z) equals the product over τ in Tau of the inverse of host.emb (eTau τ) z.

parts.name: relDet
parts.gloss: A function that gives, for each N and each pair of objects of type SDLat host.E N, an element of the quotient group Dt / UO. The dossier shows SDLat E N to be the submodules of E^N over the integers of E that satisfy an unopened condition IsSDLat.

parts.name: relDet_self
parts.gloss: The condition that relDet N L L equals 1 for all N and L.

parts.name: relDet_mul
parts.gloss: The condition that relDet N L L' · relDet N L' L'' equals relDet N L L'' for all N, L, L', L''.

parts.name: relDet_smul
parts.gloss: The condition that whenever L' is the image of L under a unitary N by N matrix γ over host.E, relDet N L L' equals the class in Dt / UO of e1Dt applied to the determinant of γ.

parts.name: rhoDet_eq_inv_muTilde_chiD_pow
parts.gloss: The condition that for all u, i and c in (mem u).C.cls i, the number (mem u).C.rhoDet i c equals the inverse of muTil (i+1) (detCls u i c) times chiD (detCls u i c) raised to the power −((R.N (i+1))/2), with the division taken in the natural numbers.

parts.name: rhoDetPrime_eq_muTilde_mul_chi_pow
parts.gloss: The condition that for all u, i and c in (mem u).C.cls (i+1), the number (mem u).C.rhoDet' i c equals muTil (i+1) (detCls u (i+1) c) times chiD (detCls u (i+1) c) raised to the power (R.N i)/2, with the division taken in the natural numbers.

parts.name: dsig
parts.gloss: A function from what₂.Tau to the real numbers.

parts.name: dsig_pos
parts.gloss: The condition that dsig ρ is greater than 0 for every ρ.

parts.name: s
parts.gloss: An object of the type that the code calls Formalism.MainNotions.S.Draft.SData, built for R, host.F, host.E, conjF, the words, Tau and hcW. Its body is not in the dossier.

parts.name: s_split
parts.gloss: The condition that for every p the optional value (s.atP p).split is present exactly when the number that the code calls Loc.resChar p is one of the two primes host.g 0 and host.g 1.

parts.name: s_HH
parts.gloss: The condition that the complex dimension of the space s.HH equals what₂.Dall.

parts.name: s_Cu
parts.gloss: For each u, a complex linear isomorphism from s.Cu u onto (mem u).A.Mu0.

parts.name: s_PlF
parts.gloss: A bijection between s.PlF and the set of nonzero prime ideals of the ring of integers of host.F.

parts.name: loc
parts.gloss: An object of type LocTheory. The dossier shows this to be a choice, for every prime l, of an object of the unopened type LocPrime l.

parts.name: locA
parts.gloss: For every prime l, an object of type LocAinf l (loc l). The dossier shows that this holds group actions actC and actT, a sequence ζ n with ζ 0 = 1, ζ (n+1)^l = ζ n and ζ 1 ≠ 1, an element ε, and an injective ring map ιA from Ainf l into the ring (loc l).R.B with compatibility conditions.

parts.name: locT
parts.gloss: For every prime l, an object of type LocTied l (loc l) (locA l). The dossier shows that this holds ring isomorphisms eB and eD from the rings (loc l).R.B and (loc l).R.BdR onto rings that the code calls Per.Bcris l and Per.BdR l, with conditions that they respect the group actions, a map φB, filtrations and the map ιA.

parts.name: nd
parts.gloss: An object of type NData R host what₂. The visible part of its body holds an algebraic closure Om of host.E, an index type Loc with a prime l i, an index j i between 1 and R.m, a place w i, complete discrete valuation rings O i that are finite over the l i-adic integers, finite sets X i, modules Mt i and characters chi i c.

parts.name: ntw
parts.gloss: An object of type NTw R host what₂ LL0 nd. The visible part of its body holds a ring automorphism cc of nd.Om, an index type Tw with primes l i, discrete valuation rings O0 i, O i and Ok i k, embeddings of LL0, and characters delta i whose inertia images have exactly 15 elements at the places in pD i.

parts.name: naut
parts.gloss: An object of type NAut nd. The visible part of its body holds field maps iotaQ and iotaQC, and for each place w a type LP w with a dimension lpDim, a sum lpSum, a twist lpTw, predicates unr, mono0 and tempered, a multiset frobEig, and laws relating them.

parts.name: nbc
parts.gloss: An object of type NBC naut. The dossier shows that it holds types AU j and Wt j with multisets satAU of size R.nV / 2 and infW of size R.nV, and injective maps embAV from naut.AV i into AU (nd.j i) that respect the local data.

parts.name: nexp
parts.gloss: An object of type NExp R host what₂ LL0 nd ntw. The visible part of its body holds finite-dimensional spaces Fm i j b with an action of the group G0g nd, central idempotents eAlg i b in a group algebra, a function eLL0 from G0g nd to LL0, and homomorphisms delU with conditions.

parts.name: ntypes
parts.gloss: An object of type NTypes naut. The visible part of its body holds a number field Mray that is Galois with commutative Galois group over host.K, multisets bc σ of pairs with the products summing to R.r, homomorphisms rbar into GL of size R.r, elements tg k v of inertia groups, and central orthogonal idempotents eSer.

parts.name: nStage_trivialCharacter_compat
parts.gloss: A condition that the code calls ntypes.IdempotentMatchesAction. Its body is not visible in the dossier.

parts.name: nStage_trivialCharacter_coeff_eq
parts.gloss: The condition that for every g in G0g nd the image under embLL of nexp.eLL0 g equals the coefficient at g of ntypes.e0. The dossier shows G0g nd to be the families of invertible R.r by R.r matrices over the integers modulo host.g k, indexed by pairs of k in {0, 1} and an element of nd.PlG k.

parts.name: nth
parts.gloss: An object of type NTh R host what₂ LL0 nd ntw nexp. The visible part of its body holds ring maps iC into the l-adic complex numbers, numbers aL i equal to 1 when ntw.l i is one of host.g k and 0 otherwise, injective evaluation maps ev, polynomial sets Harm cut out by second-order differential conditions, and maps thV, recDet and actK.

parts.name: nbr
parts.gloss: For each i in nd.Loc and each prime w of host.E containing nd.l i, an object of type LocBridge. The dossier shows that this holds a field map j from nd.Om into Om l, a group isomorphism e that is continuous in both directions from the group that the code calls Dec at w onto GK Kw, and a ring isomorphism eO from nd.O i onto OL LL.

parts.name: nbr_ind
parts.gloss: The condition that for all such i and w an element x of nd.Om lies in nd.plOm.1 w exactly when the norm of its image under the map j of nbr i w is at most 1.

parts.name: self_good
parts.gloss: The condition GoodCoef host.condN on the field LL of each bridge nbr i w. The dossier shows GoodCoef N LL to say that every x in Om l with x raised to the least common multiple of l and N equal to 1 lies in LL.

parts.name: ntwbr
parts.gloss: For each i in ntw.Tw and each prime w of host.E containing ntw.l i, an object of type LocBridge of the same kind as nbr, now with the ring ntw.O0 i.

parts.name: ntwbr_ind
parts.gloss: The condition that for all such i and w an element x of nd.Om lies in nd.plOm.1 w exactly when the norm of its image under the map j of ntwbr i w is at most 1.

parts.name: loc_tie

entries.suggests: As a suggestion only, the names point to a global arithmetic setup around a CM field E over a totally real field F, with Hermitian spaces and unitary groups, a tower of automorphic forms on class sets linked by theta-type period maps, Galois representations with crystalline and de Rham conditions tied to p-adic period rings, and Hecke data at auxiliary primes. The name D7 and the module name suggest that this is the seventh layer of a staged data package whose newest addition is the pair of determinant-character formulas for rhoDet and rhoDet'.
entries.why: The whole text of D7 and the bodies of most level-one records are visible, but several of those bodies are cut off and many conditions rest on names from deeper levels (such as ColumnsAtT, HostAx, Frame, Places, HLat and SData) that the dossier does not open.

second.kind: a Lean 4 structure, that is, a record type that bundles data fields, typeclass instance fields and proof fields
second.says: D7 is a structure with no parameters whose 141 fields, read in order, each may depend on the earlier ones. It starts from a rank record R, a host record over R, a family of Hermitian spaces sp, a positive volume function and a rows record what₂, and then adds a finite type of words with a base word u₀, a parameter family hcW and a Member record mem u for every word u. Further fields make what₂.LL a totally complex Galois number field with a star operation, embed host.E into it, match the places of what₂ with the height one primes of its ring of integers, and impose conditions on the natural numbers (mem u).A.T. The remaining fields carry linear equivalences and period identities, a commutative group Dt with characters and a relative determinant, two formulas for rhoDet and rhoDet', an SData record s, local theories at every prime, the records nd, ntw, naut, nbc, nexp, ntypes and nth with bridge and tie conditions, the forms fm with norm comparisons, a measure record cd, a jet record with its index maps, and a last condition on the signatures of the spaces sp.Y j. The structure only collects these data and conditions and proves nothing by itself.

entries.name: GlobalTheory.Fc.S0.UnitaryGroupThirdPlaceHypotheses
entries.what: a record type whose 60 fields are all propositions, so it is itself a proposition (a bundle of hypotheses)
entries.says: This is a structure in Prop with 60 fields, and each field is a proof of one named proposition. It therefore states the conjunction of those 60 propositions, with no parameters and no quantifiers of its own. Fifty-six of the fields are single named statements, most of them in a namespace called Published, and the dossier shows a body for each of these, although most bodies rest on conditions that are not opened. Three fields (litN, toHypothesesX, nLink) are themselves smaller bundles, and one field (siegelEisensteinSimplePole) has a type that unfolds to True and so asserts nothing. Several statements occur more than once, directly and again inside the sub-bundles.

parts.gloss: For IsCMExt F E σ, J with IsHermND σ J and a homomorphism π from GAd σ J to bounded operators on H with IsIrrUnitary π, there exist local objects R v of type IrrU (GPl σ J v), vectors ξ v and a map B with Flath.IsUnramFactorisation R ξ π B. These names are unopened.

parts.name: cMCurveGoodOutsidePrimeSt
parts.gloss: For every prime p with p mod 4 = 3 and 3 < p there exist a subfield F of ℂ that is a number field and a Weierstrass curve A over F with IsGoodCMCurve p F A and HasMinimalDiscriminant A (−p^3). Those two conditions are unopened.

parts.name: weberRayFieldSt
parts.gloss: For a totally complex number field K inside ℂ of degree 2 over ℚ with discriminant less than −4, a period pair L whose lattice is exactly the image of the ring of integers of K, and n > 0, the field obtained by adjoining weberSet L n to K is a number field, satisfies IsAbelianGalois over K, and satisfies IsRay for the ideal generated by n. weberSet, IsAbelianGalois and IsRay are unopened.

parts.name: discreteSeriesCoverExists

parts.name: siegelWeilUnitarySchrodinger
parts.gloss: For D of type D7, n and V with n < V.rank, V.rank ≤ 2 * n and n + wittIdx V < V.rank, and under unopened conditions on ψ, χ, θ, μ, ω, H, l, s, ν and Φ, three things hold. A descended theta function is integrable for every g, for every complex z with real part above n/2 the section sect ω H Φ z is LeftInv and satisfies Eis.CosetConv, and for every g the relation HolValueAt holds between the coset sum as a function of z, the point s0 V n and thetaInt ω ν Φ g.

parts.name: siegelEisensteinContinuation
parts.gloss: For D of type D7, V with 0 < V.rank, a with IsMaj V a and HasIwasawa, μ with IsHeckeChar and ResEta D μ b, a complex s₁ and φ in degPS V a μ s₁, the condition EisContinues V (flat V a φ s₁) holds, and for every s₀ there is a k with EisRegularAt V (flat V a φ s₁) s₀ k. These names are unopened.

parts.name: siegelEisensteinSimplePole

parts.name: schurOrthogonalitySquareIntegrable
parts.gloss: For a locally compact Hausdorff group G with a regular right-invariant Haar measure μ and a norm-preserving, strongly continuous homomorphism π into bounded operators on a complex Hilbert space H whose only closed invariant subspaces are zero and H, if one coefficient g ↦ ⟨w₀, π g v₀⟩ with nonzero v₀, w₀ is square-integrable then all coefficients are. Moreover there is a real d > 0 such that the integral of ⟨w, π g v⟩ times the conjugate of ⟨w', π g v'⟩ equals ⟨v', v⟩⟨w, w'⟩/d for all v, w, v', w'.

They are loc (a bundle of 19 local statements), aut (a bundle of 16 global statements), coh (the bundle LitCoh of 12 statements), join (the five-fold conjunction JoinOut of unopened propositions) and fe (HeckeTateFunctionalEquation, which gives functions Λ and Λ' with IsCompletedL and Λ s = archEps n * finEps χ a s * Λ' (1 − s)).

parts.name: nLink
parts.gloss: A sub-bundle Hypotheses₂ with seven fields, namely FontaineBcris (seven unopened conditions on every C of type Core l), GlobalArtinReciprocity again, BlochKatoLocal (three unopened conditions), the three statements LocalTateDualityK, LocalEulerCharK and LocalFinitenessK, and BhattScholzeIntegral. The K-statements concern finite modules M over the integers mod l^r with a continuous action of GK l K and say that H0, H1, H2 are finite with Hn trivial for n ≥ 3, that card H1 = card H0 * card H2 * (card M)^(dimension of K over the l-adic numbers), and that certain cup-product maps are bijective.

entries.suggests: The names suggest a list of published theorems taken as assumptions for an argument about unitary groups and theta lifts, covering results attributed by name to Clozel, Green, Chebotarev, Bhatt and Scholze, Bernstein and Zelevinsky, Harish-Chandra, Casselman and Wallach, Jacquet and Shalika, Flath, Dixmier and Malliavin, the Siegel-Weil formula, the doubling method, class field theory and local Galois cohomology. This is a suggestion from the names only, and the name siegelEisensteinSimplePole in particular is misleading because its content is True.
entries.why: The structure and the outer logical shape of all 60 fields are visible, but most of the statements rest on predicates and objects whose bodies the dossier does not reach, and five fields are bare names with no body.

second.kind: a structure of propositions (a bundle of 60 named hypotheses, itself a Prop)
second.says: UnitaryGroupThirdPlaceHypotheses is a structure in Prop with 60 fields, and each field is a proof of one named proposition. It takes no parameters, so holding it means holding all 60 propositions at once. Most fields have types in the namespace GlobalTheory.Published, and the rest come from UpperTheory.GalS, GlobalTheory.TwSys, HeckeCharacterZeroLocus.SiegelWeilU, GlobalTheory.Mem.LiteralAutomorphy, GlobalTheory.NRows, GlobalTheory.NLink and ReciprocityTheory.Gal. Three fields (litN, toHypothesesX, nLink) are themselves bundles with 5, 12 and 7 fields, and some of their contents repeat fields of the top structure. One field (siegelEisensteinSimplePole) has the type UnusedSlot72, which the dossier shows to be the proposition True.

parts.name: cMCurveGoodOutsidePrimeSt

parts.name: siegelWeilUnitarySchrodinger

entries.name: GlobalTheory.Fc.RL.LinkedAt
entries.what: a proposition-valued function of two arguments (a predicate on a parameter record and a test relation)
entries.says: LinkedAt takes a parameter record p and a relation r on pairs (slot, linkage) and returns a proposition. A slot is a predicate on tuples (K, X, f, T, c), where K is a context, X a record of stages, f a frame, T twisting data and c a core record over them. Unfolding the one visible layer Lg1, the proposition says that there exists a slot R such that both of the following hold. First, the condition the code calls LargeBaseCondition holds for the base predicate KPx, the slot IsBuiltE p.s and R. Second, r holds of the pointwise conjunction of the slot IsGoodE p.s with R, paired with the linkage BundleLinkage p.

parts.name: hL (implicit argument)
parts.gloss: This is a proof of the proposition RecTExists, which says that for every number field E, algebraic closure Ω, valuation subring A of Ω, finite place w of E and proof h that A lies over w, there exists a map rc satisfying a condition that the code calls IsRecT. It enters only as the index of the type of p.

parts.name: p
parts.gloss: This is a record of the type Parameters hL, whose four fields are R of type RPosition, N of type NormChoiceExtension hL, S of type SExt and Γ of type GeoP. The body uses it only through p.s, an object of the type Slots obtained by a projection the dossier does not show, and through BundleLinkage p.

parts.name: r
parts.gloss: This is an arbitrary relation that takes a slot and a linkage for BundleCondition and returns a proposition. A linkage here is a predicate on a context K, a point β of type BPt K, a real number c and a bundle b of type BundleCondition β.D β.O c.

parts.name: Lg1 (the outer shape)
parts.gloss: Lg1 KP Q Q' r' is by definition the statement that there exists a slot R with LargeBaseCondition KP Q R and r' (sAnd Q' R). Here sAnd Q' R is the slot that holds at (K, X, f, T, c) exactly when both Q' and R hold there.

parts.name: KPx (first argument of Lg1)
parts.gloss: This is the predicate on a base B and a frame f that is the conjunction of two statements. The first says that there exists δ of type FieldDat B.toPre with a condition that the code calls B.KsExact δ f, and the second is PrePin B.toPre, which says that the map iX' sends each frame vector of the space X' to the frame vector of the space X at index R.m having the same index number.

parts.name: IsBuiltE p.s (second argument of Lg1, the slot Q)
parts.gloss: This is the slot positionOf (BuiltE p.s). It holds at (K, X, f, T, c) when there exist w of type ColW X.B f T, Z of type w.Lt and a core c' over the stages w.st Z such that there exists b of the type that the code calls Built p.s K w Z c' satisfying a condition that the code calls EntC b.ker, and such that the dependent triple made of X.C, the later stages of X and c equals the triple (w.C, Z, c').

parts.name: LargeBaseCondition KPx (IsBuiltE p.s) R (first conjunct)
parts.gloss: This applies an operator that the code calls EvLg to the predicate on (K, B, f, T) which says that if KPx B f holds then, for all stage data C, W, V, S, N, G over B and every core c over the resulting stages, IsBuiltE p.s at that tuple implies R at that tuple. The dossier does not show the body of EvLg.

parts.name: IsGoodE p.s (third argument of Lg1, the slot Q')
parts.gloss: This is the slot positionOf (GoodE p.s), built in the same way as IsBuiltE p.s. Its inner condition GoodE is the conjunction of BuiltE p.s with a condition that the code calls GoodO (w.D Z) c.O.nch c.O.xd.

parts.name: fun S => r S (BundleLinkage p) (fourth argument of Lg1, giving the second conjunct)
parts.gloss: This feeds r the slot S together with the fixed linkage BundleLinkage p, so the second conjunct reads r (sAnd (IsGoodE p.s) R) (BundleLinkage p). BundleLinkage p is the linkage that holds at (K, β, c, b) when there exist q of type WPt p.s K and a bundle b' of type BundleCondition (q.w.D q.Z) q.O c such that the record type BundleWitness q b' is nonempty and the dependent triple (β.D, β.O, b) equals (q.w.D q.Z, q.O, b').

parts.gloss: The surrounding section declares a slot Q and a linkage Lk, but neither appears in the signature or the body of LinkedAt. They play no role in what the definition states.

entries.suggests: As a suggestion only, the names hint that EvLg means "eventually, for all sufficiently large scale contexts", so that the first conjunct would say that built positions eventually lie in R over good bases. On the same footing, LinkedAt would say that r holds at the good built positions cut down by such an R, together with the linkage of bundles that have a witness at a weighted point of p.

Since the base rule already applies to every triple, the text shows this closure of the always true predicate to hold on every triple too.

entries.name: GlobalTheory.Fc.R1.SlotNormCondition
entries.what: a proposition (a property of three arguments Q, Lk and N), defined by specialising a general existence statement that the code calls Row
entries.says: Given a slot predicate Q, a link predicate Lk on bundles of the type BundleCondition, and a property N of family classes, the definition is the proposition Row Q Lk H, where H sends a family class 𝒜 and a selection to the statement N (D3 3 𝒜) and ignores the selection. Unfolded one step, it states that there exists a map E, from parameter records of type Par to predicates on bundles, such that RowE Q Lk E holds, and such that for every family class 𝒜 and every raw selection σ for 𝒜, if IsSel Q Lk E 𝒜 σ holds then N holds of the family class D3 3 𝒜. Here D3 3 𝒜 is the class 𝒜 strengthened by a fixed list of further conditions, with the real constant 3 placed in the slot C0, and with the bound Fm.CYL ≤ 9 among the added conditions. A family class is a predicate on parameter families Fm of type FamP eps, for every real eps.

parts.name: Q : V4.Slot
parts.gloss: The first argument is a predicate that takes a context K of type Ctx, a record X of type Stages, a frame f of type Fr X.B.toPre, a record T of type TwDat X.B and an object of the type V4.Core K X f T, and returns a proposition. The definition only passes it on to Row.

parts.name: Lk : LkT BundleCondition
parts.gloss: The second argument is a predicate that takes a context K, a point β of type BPt K, a real number c and a bundle of type BundleCondition β.D β.O c, and returns a proposition. BundleCondition D O c is a record with seven fields R, S, P, pin, DH, C and B, where DH is a pair of natural numbers p with D.s.Del = p.1 as a rational and O.L.etaSz = D.R.m times p.2 as a real.

parts.name: N : FamClass → Prop
parts.gloss: The third argument is a property of family classes. A family class is a predicate that assigns a proposition to every parameter family Fm of type FamP eps, for every real eps.

parts.name: Row Q Lk (…)
parts.gloss: The body applies Row with the bundle type taken to be BundleCondition. Row Q Lk H says that there exists E, a map from Par to predicates on bundles over all D, O and c, such that RowE Q Lk E holds and such that for all 𝒜 and all raw selections σ, IsSel Q Lk E 𝒜 σ implies H 𝒜 σ. A raw selection for 𝒜 gives, for each family Fm in 𝒜, each real x above Fm.x1 and each index i in Fm.Ix x, a bundle over Fm.D x i, the object that the code calls objAt Fm x hx i, and the constant Fm.Csz.

parts.name: RowE Q Lk E (inside Row)
parts.gloss: This is the condition that the code calls EvP applied to the predicate on pairs κ, K which says that for every point β of BPt K with β.Is Q, every real c and every bundle b over β.D, β.O, c, if Lk K β c b holds then E κ β.D β.O c b holds. The wrapper EvP and the condition β.Is Q have no visible body.

parts.name: IsSel Q Lk E 𝒜 σ (inside Row)
parts.gloss: This says that for every real eps and every family Fm with 𝒜 Fm there exists a parameter record κ of type Par, with seven fields eps, C, cD, ch, C5, c6 and Cb, such that three things hold. They are the condition that the code calls Link κ Fm, the condition that the code calls DQ.cls7 with the trivially true predicate at Fm, and, for every x above Fm.x1 and every index i, both the condition that the code calls Built Q Lk κ at the selected bundle σ Fm hc x hx i and E κ at that same bundle.

parts.name: fun 𝒜 _ => N (D3 3 𝒜)
parts.gloss: This is the conclusion H handed to Row. It ignores the selection and asserts N of the class D3 3 𝒜, which is Des (WithChN 𝒜) 3. WithChN 𝒜 holds of Fm when 𝒜 Fm, DGamDvdF Fm, TameDistinctF Fm, BoxesF Fm, QDRowsF Fm and Fm.CYL ≤ 9 all hold. Des of that class with constant 3 adds DGamSmooth Fm, TwGood Fm, the existence of a real CH with ChosenE Fm 3 CH, TuSize Fm and DGamSize Fm.

entries.name: GlobalTheory.Mem.Top.Bl.KPx
entries.what: a predicate (a proposition-valued function) on pairs made of a record B of type Base and a record f of type Fr B.toPre
entries.says: KPx is an element of the type BaseP, which the dossier shows to be the type of functions that take a record B of type Base and a record f of type Fr B.toPre and return a proposition. For given B and f, KPx B f is the conjunction of two statements. The first statement says that there exists a record δ of type FieldDat B.toPre such that a condition that the code calls B.KsExact holds of δ and f. The second statement is PrePin B.toPre, which says that the linear map iX' of the underlying Pre record sends each basis vector of the space X' to the basis vector with the same index in the space X at index R.m. The second statement does not depend on f.

parts.name: B

On top of the Pre data it adds a number field LL that is Galois over ℚ with a star operation and an embedding embLL into ℂ, a ring map embE from the host field E into LL, two intermediate fields LL0 and Ks with Ks inside LL0, and conditions asking for certain roots of unity in Ks, LL0 and LL and for ideals of E to become principal in Ks.

parts.name: f
parts.gloss: f is a record of type Fr B.toPre, which unfolds to Chr.HFrame B.host with exponent function sending j and g to the entry e j of B.hc g. Such a record holds an object P of type PiBar (a choice of a prime of the field K above each of the two primes g 0 and g 1), an object W of type Omg (an injective character of the units of the integers modulo g k for each k), characters mu0 j, eta, chiPsi, del and del' of type HChar of the host field E, and proofs of the conditions IsMu0, IsEtaT, IsChiPsi, and IsDelta at the primes pde and pde'.

parts.name: δ
parts.gloss: δ is a record of type FieldDat P with P equal to B.toPre. It holds a subfield ray of ℂ with a proof of IsRayFieldIn for the embedding φ₀ and the ideal of the integers of E generated by the natural number g 0 * g 1 * pde * pde', a subfield jField of ℂ, a Weierstrass curve over jField with a proof of IsGoodCMCurve for the number d, and a ClassBasis of E, which is a finite family of invertible fractional ideals c i and units γ i whose classes generate the class group independently and satisfy c i raised to the order of its class equals the principal ideal of γ i.

parts.name: second conjunct, PrePin B.toPre
parts.gloss: With the star structure that the code calls host.cmStar in force, this says that for every index a below the rank of the space sp.X' and every index b below the rank of the space sp.X R.m, if a and b are equal as natural numbers then the linear map sp.iX' sends the a-th vector of the stored basis (frame) of X' to the b-th vector of the stored basis of X R.m. The symbol ∀ means for all, and Fin n is the set of natural numbers below n.

entries.name: GlobalTheory.Fc.BundleCondition
entries.what: a record type (a structure with seven fields, living in the universe Type 1) that depends on three parameters
entries.says: For a base datum D of type D7, an object O of type Obj D and a real number c, BundleCondition D O c is the type of records that bundle seven components built over the component O.ex of O. Five components are data, namely a record R, a record S that depends on R, a record P, a record C that depends on R.T and P, and a record B that depends on R, P, C, S and a scale function. One component, pin, is a proof of a proposition about R.T and P. One component, DH, is a pair of natural numbers together with a proof of two equations, the first saying that D.s.Del equals the first number read as a rational, and the second saying that O.L.etaSz equals the real number D.R.m times the second number. The real number c enters only through B, where the scale function zsc P DH.1.1 DH.1.2 c is formed from P, the two natural numbers of DH and c.

The condition faces says that there exist families Dcf and Spf indexed by all Zs whose values at P.Zs are P.Dc and P.Sp, and gamDvd says that the cardinalities of certain finite sets Gam c divide the natural number (D.mem D.u₀).C.DGam.

Here D.R.m is the field m of the rank record, which the dossier shows to be an even natural number that is at least 2, while D.s and O.L.etaSz are not opened.

The dossier shows that it holds an object X of the type called Fields, a family e of ring homomorphisms into D.what₂.LL, an object c of the type called ColRec3, a family Sp, conditions called ColTie3 and ColumnRecordCompatible, an infinite place v0 of D.what₂.LL, a finite set TU, and equations that identify P.A3, P.Gp, P.Pl0, P.I0 and P.T with objects built from c and X.

The dossier shows that zsc sends each Zs to the object z given by ZscOfNum3 applied to P.A3, P.P0, P.ψ0, ofRecord D O.L Del h0, an identity bijection, O.L.Nc and Zs, and then replaces the component l6m j by z.l6m j minus c times z.l6u and sets the component l6u to 0.
